document: ET-IV E2 — the Pareto collapse rate, measured on real candidates BEFORE any spend (the number I owed 理)
candidates: poetry/cache/e1_7B.jsonl — mlx-community/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-4bit, 300 briefs x 16 samples, temp 0.8, max_tokens 96, generated on box A. No API spend.

the_number.⚠️: E2's cost line assumed 300 pairs. The realizable n is 140. That is not a cost problem — it is FEWER calls, not more — it is a POWER problem, and it changes what q is measured on.

🔴_a_design_error_in_my_dimension_set_and.the_error: `score` is not an independent craft dimension. e1_score.score_sample computes it as `n_meter + (1.0 if rhyme_ok else 0) + mean(iamb_score)/10` — a COMPOSITE of exactly what `valid` (meter AND rhyme) and `meter` already encode. Including it alongside its own components double-counts that evidence and makes THE CHECKER'S OWN COMPOSITE RANKING a domination axis. Since `score` varies in 298 of 300 briefs while the booleans are often constant, the top-scoring candidate dominates everything it ties with — which is why the set collapses.
🔴_a_design_error_in_my_dimension_set_and.why_that_is_worse_than_a_lost_n: E2 exists to test whether a frontier judge agrees with the CHECKER'S selection. Letting the checker's composite score decide who is even SHOWN means the arm has already prejudged the thing it is measuring.
🔴_a_design_error_in_my_dimension_set_and.note_on_clean: `clean` is -oov_rate, a vocabulary/degeneracy measure computed from the same checks but NOT part of the score composite. It is a genuine independent axis and stays.

collapse_under_each_dimension_set.⚠️_METHOD_WARNING: these are listed because 理 needs them to rule, NOT as a menu to pick the largest n from. Choosing a dimension set by the n it yields is selecting an instrument on its result. The argument for dropping `score` is that it is a composite of its co-dimensions, and it would hold if it LOWERED the n.

a_separate_fact_about_the_policy_worth_r.reading: for 29% of briefs the judge would be comparing two form-BROKEN poems. That is a real property of the 7B policy at this sampling budget, and it bounds what q can mean on those briefs. It should be reported as a stratum, not averaged away.

what_is_NOT_in_this_file: no q, no self-consistency, no rating result. The dry run used the fake transport and its q values are artifacts of an alternating fake rater. Nothing here was rated by a model and nothing here cost anything.
